verdict.rationale: An invoicing SaaS could plausibly ship a natural-language assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no natural-language command interface, chat assistant, or AI agent for Zoho Invoice. The REST API, Postman collection and Zoho-wide llms.txt are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
